# portvmind_vke_cluster (Resource)

Creates or destroys a VKE Kubernetes cluster. Populates kubeconfig after the cluster is Active.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "portvmind_vke_cluster" "main" {
  # Optional when provider.project_id is set. Required for tenant_name or application credential auth.
  # project_id = "<portvmind_cloud_project_id>"

  name               = "terraform-cluster"
  kubernetes_version = "v1.35.2+rke2r1"

  node_key_pair_name = "<keypair_name>"
  cluster_api_access = "public"
  subnet_ids = [
    "<subnet_uuid>",
  ]

  worker_node_group_min_size  = 2
  worker_node_group_max_size  = 3
  worker_instance_flavor_uuid = "<worker_flavor_uuid>"
  master_instance_flavor_uuid = "<master_flavor_uuid>"
  worker_disk_size_gb         = 50
  allowed_cidrs               = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `allowed_cidrs` (List of String) CIDRs allowed to access the API.
- `cluster_api_access` (String) Cluster API access address (clusterApiAccess).
- `kubernetes_version` (String) Kubernetes version.
- `master_instance_flavor_uuid` (String) Master flavor UUID.
- `name` (String) Cluster name (clusterName).
- `node_key_pair_name` (String) PortvMind Cloud key pair name.
- `subnet_ids` (List of String) List of subnet UUIDs.
- `worker_disk_size_gb` (Number) Worker disk size in GB (minimum 20).
- `worker_instance_flavor_uuid` (String) Worker flavor UUID.
- `worker_node_group_max_size` (Number) Initial worker node group maximum size.
- `worker_node_group_min_size` (Number) Initial worker node group minimum size.

### Optional

- `create_timeout_minutes` (Number) Timeout in minutes waiting for Active status. Default 60.
- `delete_timeout_minutes` (Number) Timeout in minutes waiting for delete to complete. Default 30.
- `project_id` (String) PortvMind Cloud project ID. If omitted, the provider project_id is used when set; otherwise set this explicitly.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Cluster UUID.
- `kubeconfig` (String, Sensitive) Kubeconfig YAML after the cluster becomes Active.
- `status` (String) Cluster status (e.g. Active).
